cases.description: First allow of a counter, from genesis; fast check only.
a4: the 24 h window needs the closed bucket of hour k0 from the archive.
a3 rolled hour k0 over: Apply closes the open bucket, the new closed root covers it; full walk to genesis.
a4, full walk a4 -> a3 -> a2 -> a1 -> genesis: every link, seq step, mandate and transition checks.

a4, full walk capped at one step: a4 -> a3, and a3 is not genesis. The walk is truncated, so gate_integrity is unchecked (policy_walk_truncated) even though the cap is explicit; the policy check passes and the verdict stays valid.
a4, full walk capped at two steps: a4 -> a3 -> a2, and a2 is not genesis: last 3 of 4 verdicts checked, truncated.
a4, full walk capped at three steps: a4 -> a3 -> a2 -> a1, and a1 read genesis, so no further step is due and the walk is complete.
require_policy and no policy_allow record for the decision.
The allow record's gate signature does not verify.
The mandate record is absent.
The verifier trusts p2 only.
The verifier has no extractor for the action type.
The ClosedSet of a4's prev_state is absent.
The closed bucket of hour k0 is absent.
The bucket record under hour k0's hash holds another bucket (one sum lower): its bytes do not hash to the key.
Header trust did not pass: the T_H rules are blocked; the rest passes.
Full walk; a2's allow record is absent.
Full walk; a2's allow record has a bad gate signature.
Allowed 6000 above per_action_max 5000.
Recipient not in the allowlist.
No recipient while the asset has an allowlist.
Kind swap, mandate kinds = [transfer].
test:usd at scale 3, the mandate says 2.
agent2 decides, the mandate lists agent1 only.
valid_until one second after not_after.
Verified T_H before not_before.
The gate signed amount 100; the action bytes say 1000.
Signed prev_state holds 1800 in the hour; 300 more passes the 1 h max 2000.
Count max 2 per hour; the third allow.
5 s after the last allow, min_spacing 10.
An older T_H signed with eval_time = T_H instead of last_t.
The verdict's anchor_time is 60 s after the verified T_H.
The gate used a mandate bound to another gate.
c1 and c1x both allowed from genesis of one counter; c1x is evidence an agent received.
Control: the same target without evidence passes.
Full walk d2 -> d1 -> genesis; the successor record of genesis names d1x, an allow from the same genesis.
e2's prev_verdict_hash does not name e1's verdict.
Control: the fast check cannot see the broken link.
new_state_hash is not Apply(prev_state, delta): found by the fast check.
f3's prev_state shows 1000 in the hour instead of 1900; on it 600 more fits the 1 h max 2000. The fast check passes: the signed state is self-consistent.
The walk finds it: f2.new_state_hash != state_hash(f3.prev_state).
g1 under version 2, then g2 under version 1 of the same mandate_id.
w1 under version 1 spends test:usd only; version 2 keeps the scale of the unused test:eth and adds test:btc; full walk w2 -> w1 -> genesis finds no equivocation.
The gate adopted version 2 with test:eth at scale 6 (unused, 18 in version 1), which adoption refuses; the walk x2 -> x1 reports it.
Version 2 dropped test:eth, version 3 lists it at scale 6: no two consecutive mandates differ, but y1's and y3's do; evidence y1 and y3.
h1 signed a new state with seq 2; h2 continues from it.
i1 is above per_action_max and also forks with i1x: fail stays fail (exit 1), gate_integrity is still violated.
v1 decision whose mandate_ref equals the allow verdict's mandate_hash; reported as match.
The agent committed to another mandate; the gate allowed under its own: both inputs are signed, so this is a fail.
v1 decision without mandate_ref: the gate skipped its own rule, which the envelope alone cannot prove; reported as absent, not a fail.
Fast-mode Authorization (pending reference) under a mandate without fast_mode_max_delay: P15.
anchor_deadline - h0 = 11 above the mandate's fast_mode_max_delay 10: the gate issued a deadline beyond the principal's bound.
anchor_deadline - h0 = 10, exactly the mandate's bound.
ADR-036 mandate; this verifier build has Ed25519 and EIP-712 only.
ADR-036 mandate; the verifier pins the principal by its bech32 address (--principal cosmos:<address>).
EIP-712 mandate; the verifier pins the principal by its address (--principal eth:0x<address>).
EIP-712 mandate; the verifier pins only a Cosmos address of the same secp256k1 key: the comparison is per scheme.
A fast-mode Authorization (mode 2) makes the policy check required (core v1 10.1) although require_policy is off; the archive holds no policy_allow record: unchecked, never valid.

A strict-mode (mode 1) decision whose envelope carries mandate_ref, authorized by a gate that issued no verdict (for example a gate whose mandate was dropped and that skipped M0); require_policy is off. mandate_ref makes the policy check required (core v1 20.5): no policy_allow record, so unchecked, never valid.
Pending reference: the verdict's anchor_time is T_ref, the header time at h0, and matches the verified T_ref.
